name: n8n
description: Workflow automation tool (self-hosted), runs via docker compose.
compose:
services:
  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:latest
    container_name: panelpro-n8n
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{{ http_port }}:5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY={{ secret }}
      - GENERIC_TIMEZONE=Asia/Jakarta
    volumes:
      - n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n
volumes:
  n8n_data:
install_script:
set -e
cd {{ app_home }} && docker compose up -d
echo "n8n: http://<server>:{{ http_port }}"
uninstall_script:
cd {{ app_home }} && docker compose down -v || true
echo "n8n stack removed"
